svg.title: Ronograd vector terrain
svg.desc: Simplified vector adaptation of Gravity_Defier’s orthographic map on the BRM5 Wiki. Terrain reference dated January 2025; room research November 2026. CC BY-SA 3.0. Area anchors are approximate.
svg.metadata: Source: https://roblox-blackhawk-rescue-mission-5.fandom.com/wiki/Map:Operation_Phoenix_-_Ronograd_Island ; Gravity_Defier / BRM5 Wiki contributors; colour simplification and vector tracing. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
